theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_fderiv_norm_interpolation
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (ρ t α S K : ℝ), 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ K → 0 < t → t < ρ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball x ρ) → (∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ‖w y‖ ≤ S) → (∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ w y - fderiv ℝ w z‖ ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ≤ 2 * S / t + t ^ α * K
